evidence.reproduction_note: Two full runs, same prompt digest, same 15,271-token prompt, both capped at exactly 32,000 completion tokens. The two replies hash differently, so temperature 0.0 / seed 1 is not giving this gateway bit-identical output - which makes the agreement of the two failures evidence that the truncation is structural, not one unlucky sample.
evidence.expected_output_size: The manifest's own recorded measurement is about 69 tokens per disposition record (prompts/source_reconciliation.yaml, sampling comment) and the schema caps rationale at 160 characters, so 40 records should cost roughly 2,800 tokens. 32,000 is about eleven times that.

captured_runaway.probe: the same batch-1 request replayed with max_tokens=6000, reply captured
captured_runaway.well_formed_ids_in_the_whole_reply: 7, and every one of them is a unit_id - the one field reconciliation_schema() pins with an enum
captured_runaway.shape: Every fact_ids entry is the bare kind prefix with nothing after the colon: "public_symbol:", "link_target:", "identity:". One disposition's fact_ids array alone ran to 1,047 consecutive "public_symbol:" entries and was still going when the budget ran out.

evidence.cause: reconciliation_schema() (components/readme/reconciliation/dispositions.py, the block added by G4-W17 arrival item 40, commit e2a1a83 at 2026-09-11 06:50 +05:00) pins fact_ids items with a regex - {"type": "string", "pattern": "^(build_test_asset|...|public_symbol|...):"} - and the array carries no maxItems. The request is sent with response_format json_schema strict:true, so the gateway decodes under that grammar. "public_symbol:" satisfies ^(...|public_symbol|...): exactly, and with no bound on the array the decoder emits it until the token budget is exhausted. The binding guard that would reject a fact ID naming no fact never runs, because finish_reason=="length" raises in core/llm/jobs.py before any parsing.
evidence.regression: Pre-item-40 the same field was {"type": "string"} with no pattern (git show e2a1a83 -- .../dispositions.py). The pattern was added to stop a job filling the slot with a packet key; under grammar-constrained decoding it instead created a degenerate minimal match. The same function pins unit_id with an enum for exactly this class of reason and its own docstring argues for it.
not_the_cause: Batch size. _RECONCILIATION_BATCH=40 was suspected first and measured out: batch 1's packet is 40,988 characters and the required reply is bounded at roughly 2,800 tokens.

Packet growth from item 40's DECLARED_SYMBOL_KINDS binding. Measured on this repository's own facts: the S4 packet carries 83 fact records with the binding and 162 without it - for Go the change made the packet smaller, not larger.

fix_proven.variant: fact_ids items pinned to an enum of the packet's own 123 fact IDs, plus maxItems 12
the same enum with NO maxItems - isolating which half is load-bearing

evidence.fix_reading: The enum alone closes it: 3,560 tokens against 32,000, a ninefold reduction, every one of the 40 units covered, zero degenerate IDs, and 87 tokens per record against the manifest's own recorded 69. A maxItems bound changes nothing measurable here and is defence in depth, not the fix.
